task.description:
Design the Stage F7 Tenant Onboarding GUI (ONB-UI-01 through ONB-UI-04).

Read the four requirements in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md ## Stage F7.
Read templates/lego-catalog.md to classify each requirement (Type A/B/C/D/E).
Read docs/guides/frontend_developer_guide.md and docs/guides/frontend_design_system.md for conventions.

CLASSIFICATION GUIDANCE:
These are novel UI flows (multi-step wizard with polling) with no exact codegen template match.
Classify all four as Type E (novel) and produce a prose design in src/design/onboarding_gui.md.

The design must specify:
1. Route structure: what URL paths exist for each screen
2. Component breakdown: which screens/panels exist (no TypeScript types)
3. API integration: which endpoint each component calls, request/response shape summary
4. State flow: how data passes between the form, progress, and result screens
5. Role guard: where PLATFORM_ADMIN check is applied
6. Polling lifecycle: when polling starts, stops, and how transient errors are handled
7. Retry / pre-fill: how Try Again restores prior form values
8. Page-reload restore: how GET /api/v1/onboarding?hostname=<h> is used on mount

Do NOT write TypeScript, React, or any implementation code in the design.
All public function/component signatures are listed by NAME and BEHAVIOUR only.
Error taxonomy: list error states (validation failure, API error, saga failed, transient poll error).
acceptance_criteria: src/design/onboarding_gui.md exists and covers all four ONB-UI requirements
API integration points are listed with endpoint + request/response summary
Polling lifecycle (start, stop, transient error) is described
No TypeScript/React code in the design doc

result.summary: Designed Stage F7 Tenant Onboarding GUI covering ONB-UI-01..04 as Type E
